title: Rollout Stage
description: Configuration and live state of one production validation stage for a candidate. The experiment engine reads/writes these; the circuit breakers act on them. See experiment_design.md.

stage.description: shadow = parallel, NO real-world action, inertness enforced at network egress (sandbox proxy), carries canary-grade guardrails. canary = small sticky cohort. ramp = increasing cohort (see ramp_step_index). full = promoted.

ramp_step_index.description: Which step of the ramp ladder this stage represents (set when stage=ramp); a new rollout_stage record is created per step so step history is preserved.

exposure_pct.description: Percent of newly-onboarded couples (or clusters) assigned to the candidate. 0 in shadow.

unit.description: region_date_cluster (region x wedding-date-window) is REQUIRED for any candidate touching venue/catering/music/budget_management — shared finite vendor inventory makes per-couple assignment violate SUTVA (one arm cannibalizes the other's supply). Non-booking candidates may use couple_onboarding_cohort. See experiment_design.md.

sticky.description: Must be true: a couple does not flip between control and candidate mid-planning.

analysis_unit.description: Must match the randomization unit; cluster-randomized experiments analyze at the cluster level (or a region x month mixed model).

saturation.description: For thin clusters: vary the within-cluster exposed fraction to estimate the spillover/interference slope.

primary_metric_code.description: The VALIDATED leading-indicator metric the decision is made on (NOT the lagging wedding outcome). Only an indicator that cleared surrogate validation (Prentice/PTE) may be a primary. e.g. couple_active_minutes_total, rsvp_resolution_rate, north_star_ratio (eval-mirrored).

guardrail_metric_codes.description: Monitored continuously for HARM, independent of the primary. Breach -> auto-rollback without waiting for primary significance.

stats.description: Always-valid (sequential) inference so continuous peeking is legitimate. Knobs are pinned and recorded so a readout is reproducible.

method.description: e-values/confidence sequences preferred (compose with online FDR). mSPRT requires tau_squared pinned to the MDE. A Bayesian variant is valid ONLY as a proper sequential test with simulated operating characteristics.

expected_arrival_rate.description: Couple/cluster onboardings per week (by region/season); the denominator of every power and duration claim.

mde.description: Minimum detectable effect. Required before a promote decision; min_exposure_count is DERIVED from this, not asserted independently.

tau_squared.description: mSPRT mixture variance, pinned to the MDE; set when method=mSPRT.

prior_spec.description: Prior/e-process specification; set when method requires it. Recorded for reproducibility.

min_exposure_count.description: Minimum assigned couples/clusters before a promote decision; DERIVED from mde + power_target via a sequential expected-sample-size analysis.

min_duration_days.description: Strictly positive. Must cover the leading metric's event horizon; time-to-event leading metrics use a survival estimator, not a rate at an arbitrary cutoff.

cuped_variance_reduction_achieved.description: Measured rho^2 variance reduction; the power credit for CUPED is gated on this, not assumed.

false_discovery_control.description: ONLINE FDR over the continuous experiment stream (ADDIS when most candidates are null). Benjamini-Hochberg is BATCH_ONLY — valid for a fixed retrospective family, NEVER the live promote gate.

estimand.description: How the primary is estimated. north_star_ratio is zero-inflated & bounded — do not analyze as a raw mean.

decompose_zero_inflation.description: Analyze gate-failure rate and among-passers quality separately.

scale.description: Bounded ratios are regression-adjusted on a variance-stabilized scale, not raw.

report_quantile_effects.description: Report CDF shift / quantile treatment effects, not just the mean (catch lower-tail harm).

segments_monitored.description: Persona-mirrored cohorts (low-budget, two-cultures, multilingual-guest-heavy) to check for heterogeneity.

segment_results.description: Per-segment effect from a hierarchical / partial-pooling (shrinkage) model, tested as non-inferiority against a harm margin with BH across this FIXED segment family. Records 'we couldn't tell' distinctly from 'no harm'.

powered.description: False => underpowered: 'no harm detected' is NOT 'no harm'.

novelty_check.description: Early-tenure vs mature-tenure within the candidate arm; a gain that decays with tenure is a novelty artifact.

control_arm_interference_flag.description: For booking candidates: set when the control arm's booking-success degrades coincident with candidate ramp — an interference signal, not a candidate win.

circuit_breakers.description: Real-time harm monitors. Trip => immediate auto-rollback, logged by decided_by=circuit_breaker.

metric_code.description: Production analogue of a veto gate or critical guard, e.g. unauthorized_commit_count, qa_accuracy_rate.

breaker_type.description: hard_veto = zero-event counter (e.g. unauthorized_commit_count): trip on first occurrence, no sequential test. sequential_rate = noisy rate (e.g. qa_accuracy_rate): trip via a one-sided sequential harm test, NOT a fixed threshold (which is itself uncontrolled peeking).

threshold.description: For hard_veto: the count (typically >=1) that trips. Null for sequential_rate.

harm_mde.description: For sequential_rate: the harmful effect size the sequential test is tuned to detect.

false_alarm_rate.description: For sequential_rate: the controlled false-rollback rate.

source.description: MUST be an out-of-band / trusted source the product cannot author — never the product's self-reported stream. See safety_and_governance.md §3.

action.description: There is only one action — a breaker reverts, it does not page-and-wait.

decision.description: The engine's current call for this stage.
